title: Data Platforms Principal Engineer (SAC-Planning) - BI & Reporting
description:
Overview:

Waters is seeking a highly experienced **SAC-P Administrator** & **Senior SAC -P Developer** to manage and optimize the SAP Analytics Cloud (Planning) platform. This role is responsible for ensuring platform stability, data integrity, performance optimization, and secure access management while supporting enterprise-wide planning processes. The role will also act as a key liaison with SAP and internal stakeholders to drive operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Data Integration & Operations Management-** **Must Have**

* Monitor data loads and perform error remediation to ensure data accuracy and completeness
* Conduct reconciliation of data before and during planning cycles
* Review, troubleshoot, and remediate batch jobs to ensure uninterrupted operations
* Manage integration between SAC and boundary/source applications
* Manage and monitor Data Action executions, Multi Actions, and Planning Process workflows to ensure successful cycle completion.
* Coordinate and validate master data and hierarchy updates across planning models.
* Implement and maintain automated data validation and exception reporting processes.
* Support period-end, forecast, and annual planning cycle cutover activities.
* Ensure adherence to SLAs for data refreshes, batch processing, and issue resolution.
* **Development & Delivery of SAC Components –** **Good to Have**

* Oversee and contribute to development of SAC Stories and input templates
* Lead design and build of visualization dashboards and analytical reports
* Drive backend and UI enhancements for global reporting solutions
* Ensure high performance and usability across SAC deliverables
* Lead development of SAC Analytic Applications using scripting and advanced user interaction capabilities.
* Design and implement planning workflows using SAC Calendar, Task Chains, and Process Management features.
* Establish development standards, coding guidelines, and peer review processes for SAC deliverables.
* Create reusable templates, widgets, and reporting components to accelerate solution delivery.
* Ensure accessibility, usability, and responsive design standards across all planning applications.
* Expertise in **SAC Analytic Applications and JavaScript scripting**.
* Strong experience with **Advanced Formulas, Data Actions, Multi Actions, and Calendar Processes**.

* **Advanced Calculations & Data Actions-** **Good to Have**

* Design and implement complex calculation logic within SAC models
* Lead development of Data Actions to automate planning processes
* Optimize performance and ensure accuracy across planning scenarios
* Establish development standards and conduct quality reviews
* Design and optimize Advanced Formula scripts for complex planning, allocation, and forecasting requirements.
* Develop Multi Actions to automate end-to-end planning and approval processes.
* Build driver-based planning, top-down and bottom-up forecasting models.
* Implement allocations, currency conversion, intercompany eliminations, and spreading logic.
* Conduct performance tuning of Data Actions, calculations, and planning models to minimize processing time.

* **System Performance & Stability -** **Must Have**

* Monitor overall SAC system performance and proactively identify issues
* Analyze system bottlenecks and implement performance improvement measures
* Work closely with SAP on OSS notes, incident resolution, and follow-ups
* Apply recommended OSS notes and server-level configurations to enhance system efficiency
* Conduct capacity planning and usage analysis to support platform scalability and growth.
* Monitor model size, data volumes, and planning performance to ensure optimal system responsiveness.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.
* Validate SAC quarterly releases and assess impact on planning models, integrations, and security.
* Coordinate regression testing and production readiness activities for platform enhancements.

* **Security & Access Management-** **Must Have**

* Manage role-based access controls (RBAC), including defining who can view or edit forecasts
* Implement and maintain data-level security (e.g., region and product-level restrictions)
* Administer user roles, permissions, and assignments across SAC environments
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security and governance standards
* Periodically review user access and role assignments to ensure compliance with audit requirements.
* Manage Single Sign-On (SSO), identity provider integrations, and authentication configurations.
* Support internal and external audits by providing access reviews, security evidence, and compliance documentation.
* Establish segregation of duties (SoD) controls and monitor compliance with governance policies.
* **Platform Governance & Continuous Improvement** **-****Good to Have**

* Establish and enforce SAC administration best practices and governance frameworks
* Ensure data integrity, auditability, and compliance with planning policies
* Partner with IT, Finance, and business teams to support planning cycles and resolve issues
* Drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and user experience
* Define and maintain SAC administration standards, naming conventions, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform change requests, release schedules, and promotion activities across Development, QA, and Production environments.
* Develop and maintain operational dashboards and KPIs for platform health monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage new SAC Planning capabilities and drive adoption across business teams.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of models, integrations, security configurations, and operational processes.
* **Collaboration & Stakeholder Management -****Must Have**

* Act as the primary point of contact for SAC administration and operational support
* Collaborate with SAP, integration teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues
* Support global users and provide guidance on system usage and best practices
* Facilitate planning readiness reviews and hypercare support during critical planning and forecasting cycles.
* Partner with Finance, FP&A, and business users to translate operational requirements into platform improvements.
* Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, user training, and administrator enablement programs.
* Coordinate with SAP product teams regarding roadmap features, enhancements, and platform best practices.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to junior administrators and support team members.
* **Environment & Release Management-** **Must Have**

* Manage transport and deployment activities between Development, Test, and Production environments.
* Perform impact assessments and coordinate testing for SAC quarterly releases and platform upgrades.
* Maintain backup, recovery, and business continuity procedures for planning operations.
* Establish release governance processes and change management controls.
* Ensure production changes are documented, approved, tested, and communicated to stakeholders.

**9.Additional Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

  

* Experience with SAP Datasphere, BW/4HANA, SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Cloud Identity Services.
* Knowledge of SAC Data Actions, Multi Actions, Calendar Processes, and Advanced Formulas.
* Experience with ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Experience defining and tracking platform operational KPIs and SLAs.
* Strong understanding of enterprise planning, forecasting, budgeting, and workforce planning processes.

These additions elevate the role from a pure administrator position to a **Senior/Lead SAC Planning Platform Owner**, which is typically what enterprises expect for global SAC Planning implementations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications -** **Must Have**

* Strong hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (Planning Administration)
* Proven experience in data load monitoring, reconciliation, and batch job management
* Expertise in system performance monitoring and optimization
* Experience working with SAP OSS notes and support processes
* Strong knowledge of role-based access control and data security models
* Familiarity with data integration (APIs, flat files, enterprise systems)
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* Ability to manage operations in a global, cross-functional environment

Qualifications:

**Preferred Qualifications-** **Must Have**

* Experience in enterprise SAC Planning implementations and support models
* Familiarity with SAP ecosystem (S/4HANA, BW, Datasphere, etc.)
* Exposure to financial planning cycles and processes
* Experience supporting onshore/offshore delivery models

SAC Planning certification preferred

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
### **The Opportunity**

With Sitetracker’s customer base rapidly expanding, we’re seeing increased demand for scalable solution delivery using out-of-the-box features and advanced declarative customization. The Senior Salesforce Administrator serves as the declarative technical backbone of our team: bridging the gap between OOTB capabilities and full-stack custom code.

This role offers the chance to work in a product-led environment, balancing deep feature development with high-priority support delivery. You’ll operate as a highly hands-on builder, owning projects end-to-end and working directly with customers to design tailored solutions. For high performers, this is an opportunity to stretch your skills across analysis, consulting, and delivery within a collaborative team of Developers, Architects, and QAs.

### **What You’ll Do**

In this role, you will lead technical discovery and architecture reviews with enterprise stakeholders, defining clear boundaries and steering them toward declarative best practices. You will take a hands-on approach to building highly scalable data models, robust security architectures, and advanced enterprise-grade Flow frameworks that handle complex orchestration while preventing governor limit issues. Going beyond standard administration, you will actively architect and tune AI systems like Scout to build intelligent automations that drastically reduce end-to-end case delivery times. Furthermore, you will bridge the gap between declarative and programmatic solutions by performing code-level Apex diagnostics, managing order of execution to prevent race conditions, and mapping custom code within Flows, ultimately remediating technical debt and reducing developer overhead.

### **The Skills You’ll Have**

* #### **Advanced Flow Architecture & AI Execution**

Deep mastery of complex automation, Flow design patterns, AI system configuration, and Apex diagnostics. Proven ability to actively monitor AI telemetry and optimize accuracy.

* #### **Client Advisory & Pushback**

Strong consulting experience. Capable of evaluating business needs, confidently pushing back against bad architectural requests, and defending Salesforce best practices.

* #### **Execution Alignment & Data Architecture**

Strong conceptual grasp of enterprise data modeling, complex sharing architecture, and permission set governance. Understands execution order to seamlessly bridge declarative configuration with full-stack custom code and prevent race conditions.

* #### **High-Velocity Work Management**

High autonomy in estimating effort accurately and managing complex workloads. Successfully manages 2-3 high-effort and 4-5 medium-effort projects simultaneously while meeting strict timelines

### **Within 90 Days, You’ll:**

* Attain 80% billable utilization.
* Complete deep-dive reviews of existing client Apex frameworks, data models, and flow inventories.
* Understand the delivery processes Solution Engineering follows and pass Sitetracker Admin training/certification.

### **Within 180 Days, You’ll:**

* Autonomously drive requirement gathering meetings and design solution blueprints.
* Build and construct complex sub-flow automation frameworks, integrating with invocable Apex where necessary.
* Communicate effectively and proactively with customers regarding technical risks and timelines.

### **Within 365 Days, You’ll:**

* Architect complex, enterprise-ready solutions autonomously end-to-end.
* Help and collaborate with Developer and QA team members to deliver the best hybrid (code + declarative) solutions.
* Earn Advanced Sitetracker Certifications.

title: Salesforce Administrator II
description:
### **The Opportunity**

As a Salesforce Administrator II, you operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, automation, and customer delivery. You are not a traditional “click-only” administrator: you are a technical problem solver who understands system logic, designs enterprise-grade automations, and can bridge the gap between declarative configuration and custom code.

You will partner closely with Solution Engineers, Architects, and Developers to design, build, and maintain scalable solutions across Sitetracker and core Salesforce platforms, thriving in a hybrid Kanban environment that balances feature work with high-velocity support.

### **What You’ll Do**

In this role, you will engage directly with international stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into technical design specifications, designing and maintaining fault-tolerant Salesforce Flows and scalable security architectures. Going beyond standard administration, you will actively configure and tune Salesforce AI systems, perform complex data transformations, and leverage your foundational Apex literacy to independently troubleshoot issues using system debug logs. Ultimately, you will apply a strong understanding of architectural boundaries to determine when solutions require modular, declarative automation versus custom code, ensuring robust, prompt-driven, and highly secure workflows across the enterprise.

### **The Skills You’ll Have**

* #### **Technical Aptitude, Security & AI**

Expertise in Flow Builder, AI system configuration, Data Security, and declarative troubleshooting. Verifiable experience configuring AI systems and understanding sharing architecture, OWDs, and complex permission sets.

* #### **Proactive Communication**

Excellent oral and written skills to drive ticket momentum and explain technical limits to non-technical teams. Proven ability to provide unprompted ETA updates and set clear expectations, preventing stakeholder escalations.

* #### **Work Management**

High ability to context-switch and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment. Strong ability to balance ongoing feature projects with urgent, high-priority Kanban support tickets while consistently delivering quality work on time.

* #### **Ecosystem Knowledge & Certifications**

Foundational Salesforce platform knowledge and ongoing learning. Practical experience heavily outweighs certifications, but Salesforce Admin or Platform App Builder is preferred.

### **Within 90 Days, You’ll**

* Achieve 80% billable utilization, ensuring efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Read and trace existing custom Apex logic in client orgs to understand current-state architecture.
* Translate complex customer business requirements into detailed technical specifications.

### **Within 180 Days, You’ll**

* Manage configuration tasks across multiple projects concurrently.
* Build and deploy modular sub-flow architectures independently.
* Train others on how to use and configure the Sitetracker product.

### **Within 365 Days, You’ll**

* Lead small to medium-sized implementations end-to-end, from solution design and requirements gathering to training and go-live.
* Make critical implementation decisions autonomously, fully understanding the impact on existing code and automations.

title: Platform Security Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

We are seeking a Platform Security Architect to serve as a trusted advisor, shaping how security is embedded into modern private cloud and platform engineering environments.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, DevSecOps, and developer experience, with a strong emphasis on advisory, architecture definition, and governance. You will bring deep real-world delivery experience to ensure that recommendations are practical, scalable, and proven in production.

You will support Consult-led opportunities across the full lifecycle (pre- and post-sale), working with clients on first-of-a-kind private cloud migration and modernization initiatives, including navigating sovereignty requirements and evolving regulatory landscapes.

To our clients, you are the subject matter expert—engaging early, shaping the solution, defining architecture, and ultimately leading technical delivery.

  

Key Responsibilities

The Platform Security Architect is responsible for advising clients on the design and security of modern private cloud and platform engineering environments by defining target-state architectures, enforceable standards, and non-bypassable security guardrails. This includes shaping secure Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs), embedding policy-as-code governance, and establishing repeatable "golden paths" that enforce secure-by-default patterns across applications, Kubernetes, and infrastructure. The role also addresses the emerging threat of AI-accelerated vulnerability exploitation (informed by frameworks such as Mythos / Project Glasswing), defining architecture and controls that close the gaps adversaries can find and weaponize faster using AI — including accelerated vulnerability discovery, automated exploit chaining, and compressed attack timelines — so that platform defenses are hardened against machine-speed threats rather than human-speed ones. A key focus is reducing configuration variability, minimizing attack surfaces, and ensuring that security is inherently built into platform design rather than applied reactively.

  

In addition, the role drives end-to-end DevSecOps and runtime security transformation by integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines, identity and access architectures, secrets management, and software and AI/ML supply chains. This includes architecting developer-facing tooling and testing capabilities that keep pace with today's AI-accelerated vulnerability landscape — enabling developers to identify, validate, and remediate exploitable weaknesses at the speed adversaries now operate at, rather than relying on traditional review cycles that assume human-speed attack timelines. The role further defines control frameworks, embeds continuous compliance, enables behavior-based runtime detection, and integrates real-time security feedback into developer workflows to maintain velocity without compromising governance. The architect also leads client engagements across pre- and post-sale phases—shaping solutions, guiding large-scale private cloud modernization programs (including sovereignty and regulatory requirements), and supporting go-to-market efforts through workshops, pilots, and thought leadership that advance Kyndryl's platform security and AI-risk mitigation capabilities.
  
  
Your future at Kyndryl
  
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
Required Qualifications

* 8+ years in platform architecture, platform engineering, or security engineering, with a strong advisory focus
* Demonstrated experience designing and guiding platform transformations, not just implementing them
* Deep expertise in DevSecOps practices, secure software delivery, and CI/CD pipeline security integration
* Strong background in Kubernetes security and platform design principles
* Experience defining policy-as-code, governance models, and security frameworks
* Hands-on experience with identity, access control, and secrets management, informing advisory credibility
Experience addressing AI-accelerated attack patterns or advising on emerging AI-driven threat models, including architecting defenses and developer tooling that close vulnerability windows at machine speed  

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience advising on VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), NSX, vDefend or other private cloud platforms
* Exposure to AI-enabled security tooling and modern threat response models
* Experience with Internal Developer Platforms (e.g., Backstage) in design or advisory contexts
* Experience with behavior-based or runtime detection capabilities
* Experience supporting pre-sales or client advisory engagements, including workshops, pilots, and solution shaping
Familiarity with sovereignty and regulatory requirements in large-scale cloud modernization programs  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. title: Retail Director
description:
Role Summary

The Director – Retail owns the end-to-end P&L of the retail business and is accountable for scaling it profitably. This is a leadership role that combines commercial ownership (revenue, margin, cost) with operational transformation (process standardization, digital enablement, data-driven decision-making) across the entire store network.

The role holder will set the retail strategy, translate it into store-level targets and playbooks, build the systems and teams needed to execute at scale, and be the single point of accountability for retail performance to the leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Revenue & P&L Ownership

* Own the complete retail P&L — top-line, gross margin, store-level contribution, and operating costs — for a business of ₹15 Cr+ and growing.
* Set annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue targets by store, category, and channel; cascade them to Regional Heads and Store Managers.
* Track and drive the full sales funnel: footfall → walk-in capture → consultation → quote → conversion → average ticket size → repeat purchase.
* Identify revenue gaps early and lead corrective action plans with clear owners and timelines.
* Drive incremental revenue through CRM, referral programs and alternate channels (phygital, home consultation, catalogue-led sales).
* Own pricing and discount governance in partnership with Category and Finance.

2. Retail Operations & Store Excellence

* Review, upgrade, and own the store SOP framework. Baseline SOPs exist; the role holder is expected to raise them to a premium-retail standard, close gaps, and ensure they are lived on the floor, not just documented. Core SOP areas:
* **Staff grooming & presentation:** uniform and grooming standards, greeting protocols, floor conduct, and body language.
* **Client experience in store:** welcome and needs-discovery, consultative walkthrough, sampling and visualisation, quoting and closing, hospitality standards, and post-visit follow-up.
* **Store maintenance:** daily opening and closing checklists, cleanliness, lighting, fixtures, washrooms, air-conditioning, signage, and preventive maintenance schedules.
* **Display hygiene:** planogram adherence, sample and swatch condition, price and product tagging, damaged-piece replacement, and seasonal refresh cycles.
* Build a retail audit framework (self-audits, cluster-head audits, mystery audits, VM audits) and a monthly store scorecard against these SOPs; drive accountability on scores with clear consequences and recognition.
* Standardize store layouts, product display norms, sample management, and inventory hygiene across all formats.
* Own store productivity metrics — sales per sq. ft., sales per staff, conversion %, NPS/CSAT — and lead improvement programs against each.
* Lead new store launches end-to-end: location inputs, launch planning, staffing, training, opening marketing, and 90-day stabilization.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Category to ensure availability of high-velocity SKUs, sample sets, and display inventory at every store.

3. Digital, CRM & Retail Technology

* Own adoption and effective usage of the CRM, lead management, and store-level dashboards across the frontline; set usage KPIs and enforce them.
* Define the retail tech roadmap: identify system gaps, prioritize enhancements, write requirements, and work with Product/Tech teams to ship them.
* Build and own the retail data layer — daily/weekly/monthly dashboards on footfall, leads, conversion, ticket size, staff productivity, and store P&L — and institutionalize a data-first review cadence.
* Champion a phygital customer journey — seamless handoff between online enquiries, store visits, and post-visit follow-up.

4. Planning, Forecasting & Commercials

* Lead the annual business plan for retail: revenue, margin, store expansion, headcount, capex, and marketing budgets.
* Own monthly and quarterly sales forecasting and variance analysis; present performance, risks, and actions to the leadership team.
* Plan and execute the annual promotions calendar — seasonal campaigns, festive periods, category-led offers, clearance — with clear ROI tracking.
* Own the retail marketing budget: in-store activations, local area marketing, catchment campaigns, events, and partnerships with architects/designers/builders.
* Control store operating costs (staffing, rentals, utilities, consumables, logistics) and drive cost-to-serve improvements.

5. People Leadership & Capability Building

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing retail organization — Regional/Cluster Heads, Store Managers, Sales Consultants, and support functions.
* Design and manage the frontline incentive structure to align individual behaviour with revenue, margin, and customer-experience goals.
* Own the performance management cycle for retail: goal-setting, monthly reviews, PIPs, promotions, and succession planning for store leadership.
* Build a structured training curriculum — product knowledge, consultative selling, CRM usage, SOPs, and customer service — with certification and refreshers.
* Drive frontline engagement and retention; own hiring plans and attrition targets in partnership with HR.
* Set the culture of the retail team: customer-obsessed, data-disciplined, ownership-driven.

6. Cross-functional Leadership

* Act as the voice of the store and the customer in leadership discussions with Category, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Product, and Tech.
* Drive alignment on assortment, pricing, promotions, and inventory decisions that impact store performance.
* Represent the retail business in board / investor reviews as required.

title: Product Design Engineer- 4+ years of experience
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for a hands-on **Product Designer** to join the **Unified Management Portal desig**n team and help shape the unified experience that powers our product portfolio.
* The Unified Management Portal consolidates SonicWall's network, endpoint, email, and cloud security products into a single portal with shared SSO, navigation, and design system — a major product reset.
* This is a B2B, enterprise-grade product design role — not consumer. The designer will design for IT administrators, security analysts, network engineers, and managed service provider partners who manage security for organizations of every size, from SMBs to global enterprises.
* The work centers on density, configurability, scale, and operational reliability — not consumer-style minimalism or marketing surfaces.
* This is a builder's role on a small, senior team. The designer will own design end to end for product areas with significant business impact, partner closely with Product and Engineering, and work in an AI-augmented design environment where Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end design for one or more Unified Management Portal product areas, from discovery and information architecture through interaction design, visual polish, prototyping, and design QA.
* Design complex enterprise workflows including policy builders, dashboards, configuration wizards, multi-tenant management, alerting, and incident response screens.
* Build and maintain components, tokens, and patterns in the Unified Management Portal Figma design system.
* Generate working interactive prototypes using AI tools such as Claude, v0, Figma Make, and similar tools.
* Use Claude across the design workflow, including prototype generation, design-system documentation, research synthesis, content design, and competitive analysis.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, and Solution Architects across time zones.
* Contribute to design-system governance and documentation as the platform scales across product lines.
* Conduct usability reviews and design critiques, raising the quality bar across the team.

title: Requirements Process Lead
description:
**Position Summary**

The Requirements Process Lead is responsible for defining, governing, improving, and driving adoption of enterprise requirements management processes across product development teams. This role ensures customer, system, hardware, software, and regulatory requirements are effectively captured, reviewed, traced, validated, and managed throughout the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in requirements engineering, process management, systems thinking, stakeholder engagement, and requirements management tools such as Polarion, Jira, Jama, DOORS, or equivalent platforms. The individual will partner with Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Compliance, and Program Management teams to establish scalable processes that improve product quality, traceability, and delivery predictability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Requirements Management Governance**

* Define and maintain enterprise requirements management processes, standards, templates, and best practices.
* Establish governance models for capturing, reviewing, approving, baselining, and managing requirements.
* Drive consistency across business units, programs, and product lines.
* Ensure compliance with internal development processes and applicable regulatory standards.

**Process Improvement**

* Analyze existing requirements workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and traceability.
* Lead process transformation initiatives and change management efforts.
* Develop metrics and KPIs to measure process adoption and effectiveness.
* Facilitate continuous improvement programs based on lessons learned and audit findings.

**Requirements Quality and Traceability**

* Ensure requirements are clear, measurable, testable, and aligned with customer and business needs.
* Establish end-to-end traceability from customer requirements through product requirements, implementation, testing
* Support requirements reviews and quality assessments across project teams.
* Drive best practices for requirements decomposition, verification, and change management.

**Tool Strategy and Administration**

* Serve as the business process owner for requirements management platforms.
* Collaborate with tool administrators to define workflows, templates, integrations, and reporting.
* Support integrations between requirements repositories, JIRA, and test management systems.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, Compliance, and leadership teams.
* Facilitate workshops and reviews to align stakeholders on requirements management expectations.
* Provide guidance and coaching to teams on requirements processes and best practices.
* Support audits, assessments, and executive reporting activities.

**Training and Enablement**

* Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and user guides.
* Create onboarding materials and process documentation.
* Promote organizational awareness and adoption of requirements management methodologies.

**Must Have**

**Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in requirements engineering, systems engineering, product development, process management, or related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of experience leading requirements management processes, governance programs, or enterprise process initiatives.
* Proven experience driving cross-functional process improvements within complex product development organizations.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of requirements lifecycle management, traceability, and configuration management.
* Experience with requirements management tools such as Polarion, Jama, IBM DOORS, Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid development methodologies.
* Experience establishing metrics, dashboards, and process governance frameworks.

**Leadership Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional working groups and process councils.
* Ability to drive organizational change and adoption.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Business, or related field.
* Equivalent experience may be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
* INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) or equivalent certification.
* Experience in regulated industries such as security, IoT, aerospace, automotive, industrial, medical, or consumer electronics.
* Experience implementing enterprise-wide requirements management transformations.
* Knowledge of model-based systems engineering (MBSE).

**What We Value**

**Customer Focus** You understand that high-quality requirements begin with understanding customer needs and translating them into actionable, measurable outcomes.

**Systems Thinking** You see the big picture and understand the connections between business objectives, customer requirements, product requirements, development activities, and verification processes.

**Continuous Improvement** You challenge the status quo and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and effectiveness.

**Collaboration** You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Compliance teams to achieve shared goals.

**Ownership** You take accountability for outcomes, drive issues to resolution, and ensure sustainable process adoption.

**Excellence** You promote rigor, traceability, quality, and best practices while enabling teams to move quickly and effectively.

**Learning Mindset** You embrace new technologies, methodologies, and approaches that improve requirements management and product development outcomes.

**What's In It for You:**

* Health Insurance Coverage – comprehensive care for you and your family.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – confidential service which equips and supports you as you meet life’s challenges.
* Education Assistance – we invest in your growth so you can keep learning and thriving.
* Maternity & Paternity Leave – because family always comes first.
* Menstrual Wellness Benefit – benefit for women employees
* Bereavement Leave – time to be with loved ones when it matters most.

title: Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Who is Forcepoint?**

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

**About the Role**
==================

We are seeking a Staff/Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer to modernize enterprise infrastructure operations across endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, network, cloud, and IT service management. This is not a traditional systems administration role. The successful candidate will establish an automation-first, API-driven, AI-assisted operating model that replaces manual administration with policy-as-code, automated remediation, and intelligent operational workflows, extending the governance and security foundation already built across the environment.

The engineer will act as a technical authority and architecture leader, unifying Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, CrowdStrike Falcon, CyberArk, Freshservice, AWS, Commvault, and Juniper NGFW infrastructure into a single automation and telemetry architecture. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between writing Python, PowerShell, and Bash, troubleshooting a production authentication issue, reviewing architecture, and defining an AI-driven remediation strategy.

The organization operates as customer zero for Forcepoint's Data Security Everywhere (DSE) / DLP platform, piloting AI-assisted data security and remediation workflows ahead of general availability. This engineer will help shape how that integration extends into the broader automation and AI Ops corporate architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Endpoint Engineering & Automation**
-------------------------------------

Own the architecture and standards for the Windows endpoint platform in Intune. Design lifecycle automation covering provisioning, configuration, compliance, patching, and retirement, and sustain current patch and compliance rates as the fleet scales. Engineer Windows Autopilot workflows that enforce standard-user deployment and close local-admin exposure. Build automated software inventory auditing by reconciling Intune with CrowdStrike Falcon Discover, and design self-healing remediation for common failures.

**Identity, Zero Trust & Access Automation**
--------------------------------------------

Serve as a technical authority for Entra ID identity architecture. Automate Joiner, Mover, and Leaver workflows across Entra ID, M365, and Freshservice. Mature Conditional Access from audit mode into full enforcement. Develop AI-assisted entitlement and RBAC analysis that surfaces excessive privilege, stale access, and segregation-of-duties risk. Partner on Beyond Trust privileged-access automation, including onboarding, credential rotation, and session monitoring.

**Microsoft 365 Platform Engineering**
--------------------------------------

Architect and automate Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Conditional Access administration through Microsoft Graph and PowerShell. Establish configuration baselines and drift detection, and carry forward the SharePoint governance and versioning cleanup already underway.

**Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation Engineering**
---------------------------------------------------

Own the automation engineering practice enterprise-wide. Set standards for Terraform, Bicep, and scripting frameworks in place of one-off scripts. Build CI/CD pipelines and API-driven integrations across Intune, Entra ID, Freshservice, AWS, and Juniper, and deliver reusable automation modules other engineers can build on. Convert high-volume manual processes into automated Freshservice service catalog workflows.

**AI Ops & Intelligent Automation**
-----------------------------------

Deliver production AI-assisted capabilities, not pilots, across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and Service Desk. Implement anomaly detection and event correlation, intelligent ticket classification and routing in Freshservice, and predictive models for certificate expiration, patch compliance, and firewall licensing. Ensure every automated action carries authentication, authorization, logging, approval, and rollback controls, with human approval gates on high-risk changes.

Serve as a technical partner on the organization's customer-zero engagement with Forcepoint DSE/DLP, helping define how AI-assisted data security detection and remediation workflows integrate with the broader endpoint, identity, and ITSM automation architecture.

**Observability & Security Guardrails**
---------------------------------------

Build a unified telemetry view spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, M365, and ITSM. Implement secrets management through Key Vault, Secrets Manager, or Vault, eliminate hardcoded credentials and standing privileged access, and enforce least-privilege RBAC with full audit trails for every automated action.

**Technical Leadership**
------------------------

Define the architecture standards adopted across Infrastructure & Operations. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and partner with Network, Cloud, Security, Identity, and Service Desk leaders, shaping standards across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 10+ years in infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience designing automation (not just executing predefined procedures) in large enterprise environments.
* Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management, including Autopilot and local-admin/LAPS enforcement.
* Strong hands-on Entra ID experience: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, Zero Trust, identity lifecycle, SCIM/API-based provisioning.
* Advanced PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash; strong REST API/webhook integration and Git experience; experience with Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible and CI/CD pipelines.
* Deep Microsoft 365 administration, including Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint governance.
* Experience with EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon preferred) and vulnerability/patch management reporting.
* Understanding of 802.1X, enterprise PKI/CA, certificate deployment via MDM, and NAC/authentication troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted or event-driven production automation, including anomaly detection and automated remediation with appropriate security guardrails.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with AWS platform engineering and account hygiene.
* Direct Freshservice (or ServiceNow/Jira Service Management) administration and API integration experience.
* Experience with CyberArk or equivalent PAM platforms, and Commvault or equivalent backup platforms.
* Network automation using Python/Ansible; experience with observability/telemetry pipelines.
* Experience with LLM/AI agent frameworks and enterprise AI governance.
* Familiarity with Forcepoint DSE/DLP or Claude-based AI security tooling, or interest in shaping an early customer-zero AI/data-security integration.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert; Terraform Associate; AWS/Azure professional certification.

**Success Metrics (6–12 Months)**
=================================

* 60–80%+ of repeatable endpoint tasks automated; patch/compliance rates sustained or improved.
* Automated Joiner/Mover/Leaver workflows live; Conditional Access moved from audit to full enforcement.
* Infrastructure changes delivered through Git/CI/CD with reusable modules adopted across teams.
* Proactive certificate, firewall, and endpoint compliance monitoring in place.
* Multiple AI Ops use cases in production (ticket classification, automated low-risk remediation) with measurable reduction in mean time to detect/resolve.

**Role Positioning**
====================

This role is measured by outcomes, not ticket volume: **tickets eliminated, processes automated, incidents prevented, risk reduced, engineering capacity created.**

The right candidate can architect a solution, build the automation, secure it, measure it, and roll it back if needed. This is an automation and platform architect who codes fluently, not an administrator who happens to know Intune and Freshservice.

*Don’t meet every single qualification? Studies show people are hesitant to apply if they don’t meet all requirements listed in a job posting. Forcepoint is focused on building an inclusive and diverse workplace – so if there is something slightly different about your previous experience, but it otherwise aligns and you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply. You could be a great candidate for this or other roles on our team.*

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to* *recruiting@forcepoint.com**.*

We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

EDUCATION • Degree or equivalent work experience equally preferable. • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Computer Science or related discipline CERTIFICATIONS • Relevant technical and industry certifications preferred such as CISSP,ISSMP, SANS, GCIA, CISM, EnCE, CEH, GCFA, GCFE, GCIH, or GSEC WORK EXPERIENCE • Experience working in global, complex, matrix-managed organization • Experience working directly in Cybersecurity Operations or Information Security • Experience in Incident Response and Forensic Investigations work • Experience in threat and vulnerability management • Experience working within the Financial Services Industry preferred • Experience in one or more security domains including Security Governance and Oversight, Security Risk Management, Network Security, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response and Forensics preferred • Experience with information security risk management, including conducting information security audits, reviews, and risk assessments. FUNCTIONAL SKILLS • Knowledge in one or more security domains including Security Governance and Oversight, Security Risk Management, Network Security, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response and Forensics • Knowledge of the following areas: IT security, incident handling and response, exploit analysis, intelligence gathering, digital forensics methods and procedures. • Familiar with forensic security tools. • Ability to document and explain technical details in a concise, understandable manner. • Knowledge of Information Assurance concepts and technologies. • Knowledge of cloud computing security, network, operating system, database, application, and mobile device security. • Knowledge of vulnerability management and remediation. • A diverse skill base in both product security and information security including organizational structure and administration practices, system development and maintenance procedures, system software and hardware security controls, access controls, computer operations, physical and environmental controls, and backup and recovery procedures. FOUNDATIONAL SKILLS • Communicates effectively • Identifies multiple paths to success through the development of analytical, critical thinking, and decision-making skills • Exercises sound judgement and strives for continuous improvement • Demonstrates optimism, resilience, flexibility, and openness to others' ideas • Learns while doing • Actively listens and asks thoughtful questions • Leverages available technology to achieve efficiency and results • Engages inclusively and with intent • Always acts with integrity • Analytical thinking • Iterative problem-solving • Serving as a trusted advisor RESPONSIBILITIES • High Level Responsibilities: • Examine computers, related hardware, network traffic, related applications, and operating systems to identify potential threats, anomalous or malicious activities to network resources; conduct strategic assessments on systems and networks; provide tactical analyses and suggestions; generate detailed reports for management; take effective measures to prevent and reduce cyber security incidents. • Apply forensic methods and techniques to test hardware/software equipment, operating systems, and memory for electronic data trails detection, and device records tracing; collect and analyze investigative information and data to identify signs or sources of compromise, poor security practices, and unauthorized activities; conduct a range of data forensic investigations of information security incidents • Collect, document, assess, and analyze cyber threat information from various data sets; present reports and findings to management; recommend proactive practices to reduce computer crime. • Execute first-level incident responses for reported and detected incidents; provide technical assistance to other incident response and security operation teams. • Perform security audit on regular basis to ensure compliance with cyber security policies and standards; provide reports and documents regarding network security incidents details and outcome; assist in troubleshooting problems and recommend vulnerability corrections. • Reconstruct damaged computer systems and recover damaged or destroyed data; review forensic images; determine solutions for recovery of potentially relevant information. • Details: • Review internal logs and alerts to detect potential cybersecurity events. Triage cases based on output from automated alerts, and determine when to escalate to Tier 2/3 resources • Monitor external service provider(s) activity to detect potential cybersecurity events • Assist with investigations by consolidating logs across multiple internal/external environments and performing correlation analysis • Identify and block known bad signatures or behavior of attacks • Help manage the process to create tickets when potential incidents are identified • Develop common tools and templates and workflow to standardized event and incident reporting • Review log coverage and determine whether appropriate logs are maintained and available to support incident detection and response efforts • Evaluate potential security products, technical solutions, and capacity requirements to meet business needs and recommend changes to mitigate risk • Maintain knowledge of industry trends and current security practices • Document incident response (IR) procedures that include a definition of personnel roles for handling incidents • Establish alert thresholds to determine when to convene the CIRT and investigate incidents • Analyze security data from all systems in real time to spot and thwart potential threats, attacks, and other violations • Conduct periodic incident scenario sessions for personnel associated with the incident response team to ensure that they understand current threats and risks, as well as their responsibilities in supporting the IR process • Analyze compromised systems and remediate to a clean state • Identify when protected data such as PHI or PII was compromised • Perform breach indicator assessment to investigate network traffic for malicious activity • Perform malware analysis to determine the different components, its behavior, and locations throughout the network • Assist with internal or third-party employee investigations • Provide technical support for eDiscovery investigations, breach lawsuits, and other legal cases • Use data indexing and search capabilities to provide accurate information when eDiscovery requests are received • Scrub and redact sensitive data, including employee and client data, prior to delivery to outside parties • Researched evolving IR and Forensic techniques and tools in support of incident response efforts • Assist in the production of threat intelligence reports (FS-ISAC, DHS, etc.) which identify relevant upcoming and ongoing threats to the enterprise • Identify new threats and vulnerabilities using sources such as threats identified by institution staff and known threats identified by information sharing and analysis organizations and other non-profit and commercial organizations • Support SMEs in performing detailed threat modeling to identify where the business and relevant IT systems are vulnerable and model those threats according to type, severity, and target • Monitor and analyze industry and privately obtained vulnerability data • Research evolving threats, techniques, and tools in support of threat intelligence efforts • Stay current with information security program developments, industry frameworks, and changes in the company that may impact reporting • Assist in supporting the vulnerability scanning process • Document a prioritized list of the most critical vulnerabilities along with the risk scores • Support in performing TSS Policy compliance scanning to identify when IT assets violate security requirements and policy • Update the scanner regularly to enable the identification of new security vulnerabilities • Establish a dedicated account for authenticated vulnerability scans and grant access to a limited number of employees • Perform vulnerability analysis and assists in generating reports for stakeholders to remediate • Perform periodic asset discovery and gap analysis to report rogue devices • Subscribe to a vulnerability intelligence service to stay aware of emerging exposures, and use the information gained from this subscription to update the organization's vulnerability scanning activities • Risk-rate vulnerabilities based on the exploitability and potential impact of the vulnerability, and segmented by appropriate groups of assets • Perform TSS Policy compliance scanning to identify when IT assets violate security requirements and policy • Establish expected patching timelines based on the risk rating level • Measure the delay in patching new vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) • Review critical patches in the test environment prior to pushing them into production on enterprise systems • Assist system owners in the remediation of IT assets which violate Technology Security Standards • Monitor logs associated with scanning activity and associated administrator accounts to ensure that all scanning activity is limited to the timeframes of legitimate scans • Track and report vulnerability remediation progress

title: IT Administrator
description:
Job Description:

**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**

Transforming the insurance industry is ambitious, we know. That’s why at Applied Systems India Pvt Ltd., an Applied Systems company, we’re building a team that shows up every day ready to learn, willing to try new things, and driven to deliver innovative software and services that make us indispensable to our customers – all within a culture built on values that make us indispensable to each other too. With 40+ years of experience in the Insurtech game, we’re not just redefining what’s achievable, we’re creating a place where amazing career moments are made possible.

**Position Overview**

The IT Administrator will be responsible for handling end-user support, JIRA Service Desk, IT hardware inventory

management, automation through workflow tools, and hardware analytics using unique monitoring solutions.

The role also requires a good understanding of cloud infrastructure, support, and monitoring.

**What You will Do**

* Provide expert end-user support across Windows, Mac, and mobile platforms.
* Administer and optimize JIRA Service Desk for ITSM processes, including workflow automation and

reporting.

* Manage IT hardware inventory lifecycle, including procurement, asset tracking, audits, and

decommissioning.

* Implement and maintain automation for IT processes using workflow tools (e.g., JIRA automation,

ScriptRunner, REST APIs).

* Oversee ITSM processes such as incident, problem, and change management, ensuring adherence to ITIL

or similar frameworks.

* Perform hardware analytics using advanced monitoring tools (such as NinjaOne, ManageEngine

OpManager, Datadog, Atera), leveraging real-time data, automated alerts, and customizable dashboards

to proactively monitor, analyze, and report on hardware health and performance.

* Support and monitor cloud infrastructure, utilizing monitoring tools to track resource utilization, system

health, and performance across on-premises and cloud environments.

* Collaborate with IT and business teams to identify and implement process improvements.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation for ITSM processes, hardware analytics, and cloud support

procedures.

* Train and mentor end users and junior IT staff on ITSM tools, hardware monitoring, and automation

practices.

* Ensure compliance with security and governance standards.

**What You will Need to Succeed**

* 2-3 years of experience in IT support or engineering roles, with strong ITSM and end-user support background.
* + Proven experience administering and optimizing JIRA Service Desk, including workflow configuration and automation.
* · Hands-on experience with IT hardware analytics and monitoring using unique tools such as NinjaOne, ManageEngine OpManager, Datadog, Atera, or similar platforms. · Solid understanding of ITSM frameworks (such as ITIL), with practical experience in incident, problem, change, and asset management. · Experience with automation tools and scripting (e.g., Tines, PowerShell) for workflow and process automation. · Good basic understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts, including support and monitoring using relevant tools. · Proficient in Windows, Mac OS, and mobile device management. · Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, Active Directory, and security best practices. · Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills. · Ability to document technical processes and conduct user training. · ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM qualification preferred. Preferred Qualifications · Experience with additional ITSM tools (e.g., Jira Service Management, ServiceNow & Freshservice). · Certifications in ITIL, Microsoft, or related technologies. · Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and identity management solutions

**When You Join Team Applied, You Can Expect:**

**A culture that values who you are** and recognizes that you aren’t just an employee; you are a teammate, and you matter. We thrive on the benefits of our different experiences and celebrate the uniqueness our teammates bring to work with them every day.

**We flex our time together**, collaborating remotely and in-person to empower our teams to work in the ways that work best for them.

**Learn more about the people behind our products at** –

* LinkedIn Page Applied Systems India
* https://www1.appliedsystems.com/en-us/about-us/jobs/

**Your Security Matters:**

Our candidates’ personal information and online safety are top of mind for us. At Applied, we proactively protect your personal information and only communicate with candidates via a secure @appliedsystems.com email or through our official careers’ portal.

**EEO Statement**

Applied Systems is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Diversity and Inclusion is a business imperative and is a part of building our brand and reputation. At Applied, we don’t discriminate, and we are committed to recruit, develop, retain, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

title: Senior Support Engineer
description:
**Senior Support Engineer**

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Support Analyst is responsible for ensuring the stability, availability, performance, and operational support of the Fenergo KYC SaaS platform and its associated integrations.

The role combines Production Support, ITIL Service Management, and SRE practices to deliver reliable and efficient support services across business-critical KYC and Client Lifecycle Management processes. The individual will act as a key member of the L1/L2 support function, working closely with Business Users, Fenergo Managed Services, Engineering Teams, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, and Service Management teams to resolve incidents, improve platform reliability, and support operational excellence.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Support & Service Operations**

* Provide L1/L2 support for the Fenergo platform and associated integrations.
* Monitor application health, service availability, and operational performance.
* Investigate and resolve incidents, service requests, and production issues within agreed SLA targets.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting across application, integration, infrastructure, and data layers.
* Conduct impact analysis and coordinate resolution activities during service disruptions.
* Support major incident management activities and bridge calls.
* Maintain operational support documentation, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Perform post-incident reviews and contribute to root cause analysis activities.
* Participate in on-call and out-of-hours support rotations where required.
  

**Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)**

* Support implementation of SRE best practices across the platform.
* Monitor and maintain Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Identify recurring issues and reliability improvement opportunities.
* Assist in implementing automation solutions to reduce manual operational effort.
* Analyse trends, alerts, and system behaviour to proactively prevent incidents.
* Support performance tuning and capacity management activities.
* Contribute to resilience and service availability improvements.
  

**ITIL Service Management**

* Execute Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Request Fulfilment processes.
* Support Major Incident Management activities and stakeholder communications.
* Participate in Problem Management investigations and root cause analysis.
* Ensure operational activities comply with agreed ITIL processes and controls.
* Support Change Reviews, CAB activities, and implementation planning.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates and service records in ServiceNow.
* Contribute to Continual Service Improvement initiatives.
  

**Monitoring & Observability**

* Monitor platform health using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Investigate alerts and performance degradation events.
* Maintain operational dashboards and monitoring configurations.
* Analyse logs, metrics, traces, and system events to diagnose issues.
* Identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.
* Support implementation of proactive monitoring and alerting capabilities.
  

**Operational Readiness & Release Support**

* Support production readiness reviews for new releases and enhancements.
* Validate monitoring, support documentation, and operational procedures before deployment.
* Participate in deployment and release support activities.
* Assist with knowledge transfer sessions and support transition activities.
* Verify operational acceptance criteria are met before go-live.
  

**Disaster Recovery & Resilience**

* Support Disaster Recovery testing and validation activities.
* Execute recovery procedures during planned DR exercises.
* Validate resilience controls and recovery documentation.
* Assist in identifying continuity and recovery risks.
* Ensure disaster recovery runbooks remain accurate and current.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Fenergo Managed Services and third-party suppliers to resolve issues.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Development teams for defect resolution.
* Engage with business users during incident investigation and service restoration.
* Participate in operational governance, support, and service review meetings.
* Escalate risks, recurring issues, and service concerns appropriately.
  

**Required Experience**

* 8-10 years of experience in Application Support, Production Support, or Service Operations roles.
* Experience supporting business-critical enterprise applications.
* Strong experience in ITIL-based support environments.
* Proven experience in Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
* Experience supporting SaaS and cloud-hosted applications.
* Experience working within financial services, banking, compliance, or regulated environments.
* Experience supporting production systems with strict SLA commitments.
* Experience managing high-priority incidents and service outages.
  

**Technical Skills**

**Essential**

* ITIL Service Management
* Incident, Change & Problem Management
* Production Support
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* ServiceNow
* Monitoring & Observability Tools
* Log Analysis and Troubleshooting
* Application & Integration Support
* SQL/PLSQL Querying and Data Analysis, Snowflake and PowerBI
* API and Web Service Troubleshooting
* Release & Deployment Support
* Operational Readiness Processes
* Disaster Recovery Support Activities

**Desirable**

* Fenergo Platform Experience, Fenergo SaaS Operations
* AWS Cloud Services
* Monitoring Tolls: DataDog, Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, AppDynamics
* DevOps, CI/CD Concepts
* Financial Crime, AML/KYC Platforms
  

**Domain Knowledge**

* Understanding of KYC lifecycle processes.
* Knowledge of Client Onboarding and Due Diligence workflows.
* Understanding of Financial Crime and AML/KYC processes.
* Familiarity with workflows, integrations, and data-driven applications.
* Understanding of operational risk and service resilience requirements.
  

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively during high-pressure incidents.
* Strong customer and service focus.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within global teams.
* Proactive approach toward operational improvements and automation.
  

**Preferred Certifications**

* ITIL v4 Foundation or Managing Professional
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals / Administrator
* SRE Foundation Certification
* ServiceNow Fundamentals
* Agile or Scrum Certification
  

**Key Accountabilities / Success Measures**

* SLA Compliance and Service Performance.
* Reduction in recurring incidents and operational defects.
* Improved MTTR (Mean Time to Resolve).
* Successful support of production releases and deployments.
* Accurate and timely incident updates.
* High-quality root cause investigations.
* Contribution to automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Successful DR testing participation and operational readiness activities.
* Positive stakeholder and business user feedback.

title: Lead Engineer - Managed Kubernetes
description:

You create, own and are responsible for the application architecture that best serves the product in its functional and non-functional needs. You identify and drive architectural changes to accelerate feature development or improve the quality of service (or both). You have deep and broad engineering skills and are capable of standing up an architecture in its whole on your own, but you choose to influence a wider team by acting as a “force multiplier”. Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

We are looking for a **Lead Engineer – Kubernetes Platform** with extensive platform engineering experience in designing, building, automating, and operating cloud-native platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, and platform automation, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence. This role will provide technical leadership in evolving our Kubernetes platform across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.

**Required Skills**

* Strong software development experience in **Go (Golang)**.

* Extensive hands-on experience designing, administering, and operating Kubernetes platforms, including cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and production operations.

* Strong experience running Kubernetes on public cloud platforms. Experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP****)**and **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)** is preferred; equivalent experience with AWS, Azure, or other public cloud platforms is also acceptable.

* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture and networking, including CNI plugins, ingress controllers, services, network policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and service connectivity.

* Experience with **Infrastructure as Code (****IaC****)** and Kubernetes deployment tools such as **Terraform**, **Helm**, and **Kustomize**.

* Experience implementing **GitOps** practices using tools such as **Argo CD** and/or **Flux**.

* Strong understanding of CI/CD automation and modern software delivery practices for Kubernetes platforms.

* Experience with observability solutions, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, and platform reliability.

* Experience administering Linux operating systems and optimizing container host environments.

* Experience with Kubernetes storage technologies, including CSI drivers, Persistent Volumes (PV), Persistent Volume Claims (PVC), Storage Classes, StatefulSets, and disaster recovery strategies.

* Strong automation-first mindset with experience managing infrastructure and platform services as code using version control, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code practices.

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification is a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, automate, and operate Kubernetes platform services across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.

* Develop platform tooling, controllers, and automation using Go (Golang).

* Design, implement, and manage GitOps and CI/CD workflows to automate application and infrastructure deployments across multi-cluster Kubernetes environments.

* Manage, optimize, and scale Kubernetes clusters, including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and the supporting cloud infrastructure.

* Drive platform observability, reliability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence.

* Lead platform initiatives including Kubernetes upgrades, cluster migrations, networking enhancements, storage architecture, scalability improvements, and platform modernization.

* Define platform architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical strategy.

* Partner with engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and self-service cloud-native platform capabilities.

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert, mentor engineers, and influence engineering best practices across teams.

* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define platform roadmaps and balance product requirements with long-term platform sustainability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related field.

* Manage DNS, DHCP, Active Directory and other core infrastructure services.

* Administer Microsoft 365 users, licenses, groups, mailboxes and permissions.

* Maintain accurate IT asset and device records.

* Manage and monitor MFA and privileged access.
* Identify security gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Support security audits, compliance requirements and ISO-related IT activities.
* Maintain appropriate IT documentation and security procedures.

* Manage employee onboarding and offboarding from an IT perspective.
* Create and manage user accounts and access.
* Troubleshoot Windows and application-related issues.
* Coordinate with external vendors and support teams where escalation is required.

**IT Improvement & Ownership**

* Identify recurring IT problems and perform root-cause analysis.
* Implement permanent solutions rather than repeatedly resolving the same issue.
* Review existing IT tools and recommend ways to improve their utilization.
* Maintain IT SOPs, documentation, asset registers and configuration records.
* Prepare periodic IT infrastructure and security reports.
* Maintain an improvement tracker with clear ownership, timelines and outcomes.

**Required Skills**

* 4–7 years of experience in IT infrastructure/system administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with **Microsoft 365 Administration**.
* Experience with **Endpoint Central / ManageEngine** or equivalent endpoint management tools.
* Strong knowledge of Windows administration and Active Directory.
* Good understanding of networking — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi and VPN.
* Hands-on experience with firewalls such as **FortiGate, Sophos, Check Point or equivalent**.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender or other endpoint security solutions.
* Experience managing laptops, software deployment and patch management.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Experience coordinating with IT vendors and service providers.
* Good documentation and communication skills.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with SharePoint and OneDrive administration.
* Experience with Azure / Entra ID.
* PowerShell scripting/automation.
* Experience with ISO 27001 or other IT compliance frameworks.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence or IT ticketing systems.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure across multiple locations.
* Relevant certifications such as **Microsoft, CCNA, Fortinet, ITIL or CompTIA**.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Proactive rather than purely ticket-driven**
* Comfortable taking **end-to-end ownership** of IT systems.
* Able to work independently and prioritize competing requirements.
* Capable of identifying recurring issues and driving them to permanent resolution.
* Interested in **optimizing and improving IT infrastructure**, not just maintaining it.
* Comfortable working with both technical teams and business users.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Stability and reliability of IT infrastructure.
* Endpoint and patching compliance.
* Microsoft 365 security and access management.
* Timely resolution of IT issues.
* Reduction in recurring IT problems.
* Effective onboarding/offboarding.
* Accurate IT asset and documentation management.
* Implementation of measurable IT infrastructure improvements
