title: Senior Linux and Zabbix Administrator
description:
Job Description – Senior Linux and Zabbix Systems Engineer  
  
Experience  
  
6 8 years of relevant experience in Zabbix administration and Linux server operations.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  
  
Linux Administration:  
. Strong hands on experience in RHEL and Ubuntu administration.  
. L3 level troubleshooting of complex Linux OS, boot, kernel, filesystem, network, and performance issues.  
. Red Hat Satellite administration, including content lifecycle management, patching, repository management, activation keys, and host management.  
. Ubuntu server administration, including patching, upgrades, and advanced troubleshooting.  
. Strong experience with Ansible and infrastructure automation.  
. Support virtualization and cloud infrastructure, including VMware, KVM, Hyper V, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.  
. Support Linux environments hosted on virtualized and cloud platforms, including exposure to AWS infrastructure automation using Ansible.  
. Build, configure, administer, and lifecycle manage physical and virtual Linux servers running RHEL 7/8/9 and Ubuntu.  
. Perform server provisioning, OS installation, configuration, standardization, hardening, patching, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance.  
. Plan and execute RHEL OS upgrades, including RHEL 7 to RHEL 8/9 where applicable, and troubleshoot issues during and after upgrades.  
. Build, configure, and maintain Pacemaker/Corosync/PCS high availability clusters, including cluster resources, resource groups, constraints, quorum, fencing/STONITH, and failover policies.  
. Support clustered environments including SAP HANA on AWS and Pacemaker based HA solutions.  
. Manage core Linux components including systemd, processes, services, users, groups, permissions, sudo, SSH, cron, filesystems, LVM, RAID, and networking.  
. Manage enterprise storage, including LVM, multipathing, NFS, SAN, RAID, and filesystem troubleshooting.  
. Perform advanced troubleshooting and L3 level root cause analysis of Linux OS, boot, kernel, filesystem, network, storage, application, and performance issues.  
. Analyze system logs and troubleshoot boot failures, kernel issues, critical services, connectivity problems, and resource related incidents.  
. Perform performance tuning and capacity management for CPU, memory, disk I/O, filesystems, and network resources.  
. Manage Linux networking, including DNS, routing, bonding, firewall configuration, and connectivity troubleshooting.  
. Implement and maintain Linux security controls, including SELinux, firewalls, PAM, SSH security, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.  
. Administer Red Hat Satellite, including content lifecycle management, repository management, patching, activation keys, and host management.  
. Perform OS patching and security updates in accordance with organizational standards and vulnerability management requirements.  
. Automate administrative and infrastructure tasks using Bash/Shell scripting, Python, and Ansible.  
. Develop and maintain Ansible automation for server provisioning, configuration, patching, and infrastructure management.  
. Manage production incidents, service requests, problems, and changes within agreed SLAs and 24x7 operational environments.  
. Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical and recurring infrastructure issues and implement corrective/preventive actions.  
. Coordinate with application, database, storage, network, security, and cloud teams for infrastructure operations and issue resolution.  
. Create and maintain SOPs, technical documentation, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.  
. Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and contribute to knowledge management and operational improvement.  
  
Zabbix Administration:  
Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Zabbix Server, Zabbix Agents, and Zabbix Proxies.  
Configure monitoring for Linux servers, applications, databases, network devices, and other infrastructure components.  
Create and maintain hosts, host groups, templates, items, triggers, discovery rules, actions, and dashboards.  
Configure Zabbix agents and agent based monitoring across Linux servers.  
Develop and customize monitoring templates based on operational requirements.  
Configure thresholds, triggers, alerts, and notification mechanisms.  
Troubleshoot Zabbix monitoring failures, false alerts, and agent connectivity issues.  
Perform Zabbix upgrades, patching, configuration changes, and health checks.  
Manage Zabbix users, roles, authentication, and access permissions.  
Configure and troubleshoot Zabbix proxies in distributed monitoring environments.  
Analyze monitoring trends and identify recurring infrastructure issues.  
Maintain Zabbix documentation, monitoring standards, and operational procedures.

title: Front Desk Receptionist
description:
Position Details

Particulars

Details

Job Title

Front Office Executive

Department

Front Office / Administration

Reports To

Front Office Supervisor / Hospital Administrator

Location

Surgiderma Hospital

Employment Type

Full-time

Working Hours

As per hospital shift schedule

1. Job Summary

The Front Office Executive is responsible for managing the hospital's reception and patient coordination activities, ensuring a smooth, professional and welcoming experience for patients, attendants and visitors. The role involves patient registration, appointment scheduling, billing coordination, handling enquiries, maintaining records and coordinating with doctors, nursing staff, insurance and other departments to ensure efficient hospital operations.

2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Patient Reception & Registration

* Welcome patients, attendants and visitors courteously and professionally.
* Register new patients and update existing patient details accurately in the Hospital Management System (HMS).
* Verify patient information, contact details and appointment records.
* Issue OPD registration slips, patient files and tokens, wherever applicable.
* Guide patients to the respective doctors, departments, diagnostic services and treatment areas.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and follow hospital policies.

B. Appointment & Patient Coordination

* Schedule, confirm, reschedule and cancel appointments as required.
* Coordinate with doctors, consultants, therapists and nursing staff regarding patient appointments.
* Inform patients about appointment timings, waiting periods and consultation procedures.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, review appointments and treatment schedules.
* Support patient flow management to minimize waiting time.

C. Billing & Payment Coordination

* Coordinate OPD consultation, procedure and treatment billing.
* Generate bills, receipts and payment acknowledgements using the hospital billing system.
* Handle cash, card, UPI and other approved payment methods in accordance with hospital procedures.
* Coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding billing discrepancies, refunds and pending payments.
* Maintain accurate daily billing and cash-handling records, wherever assigned.

D. Insurance & TPA Coordination

* Guide patients regarding insurance, cashless facilities and reimbursement procedures.
* Coordinate with the Insurance Department for pre-authorization, document collection and claim-related enquiries.
* Ensure that required patient documents are collected and forwarded to the concerned department.
* Follow up on pending insurance documentation in coordination with the Insurance Team.

E. Patient Enquiries & Customer Service

* Respond to telephone calls, walk-in enquiries, emails and online appointment requests.
* Provide accurate information regarding hospital services, consultation schedules, procedures and available facilities.
* Handle patient complaints and concerns politely and escalate unresolved issues to the supervisor.
* Maintain a patient-friendly environment and support patient satisfaction initiatives.
* Assist elderly patients, persons with disabilities and patients requiring additional support.

F. Coordination with Hospital Departments

* Coordinate with OPD, nursing, pharmacy, laboratory, aesthetic services, procedure rooms and Accounts.
* Communicate patient requirements and appointment updates to the concerned departments.
* Coordinate with housekeeping and security to maintain a clean, safe and organized reception area.
* Support admission, discharge and patient transfer procedures, wherever applicable.
* Ensure timely communication of operational issues to the Front Office Supervisor.

G. Documentation & Record Maintenance

* Maintain patient registration records, appointment registers and enquiry logs.
* Maintain daily patient footfall, consultation and billing reports, as assigned.
* Ensure proper filing and retrieval of patient-related documents in accordance with hospital policies.
* Maintain confidentiality of medical records and personal information.
* Assist in preparing reports and documentation required for internal audits and NABH assessments.

H. Quality, Safety & NABH Compliance

* Follow hospital SOPs, patient rights and responsibilities, and infection prevention practices.
* Comply with patient identification, confidentiality and data protection procedures.
* Maintain professional grooming, punctuality and workplace discipline.
* Participate in staff training, fire safety drills, emergency response training and quality improvement activities.
* Report incidents, patient grievances, safety concerns and service deviations to the supervisor.
* Support NABH documentation and implementation of applicable front office quality standards.

3. Educational Qualification & Experience

* Qualification: Any degree or diploma in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* Experience: 1–3 years of experience in hospital reception, front office or healthcare customer service preferred.
* Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to learn may also be considered.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, email and hospital management software is desirable.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Pleasant personality, professional grooming and a patient-friendly attitude.
* Good interpersonal, coordination and problem-solving skills.
* Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in MS Office.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and manage patient flow during peak hours.
* Good telephone etiquette and customer service skills.
* Accuracy in data entry, billing coordination and documentation.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive patient interactions.
* Teamwork, time management and adaptability.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Sl. No.

Performance Parameter

Measurement

1

Patient Registration Accuracy

Accurate and complete patient records

2

Appointment Management

Timely scheduling and minimal appointment errors

3

Patient Waiting Time

Efficient patient flow and reduced avoidable delays

4

Patient Satisfaction

Patient feedback and complaint resolution

5

Billing Accuracy

Accurate billing and payment documentation

6

Telephone & Enquiry Handling

Timely and professional response

7

Interdepartmental Coordination

Timely communication and follow-up

8

Documentation

Accurate and up-to-date registers and reports

9

Attendance & Punctuality

Compliance with duty schedules

10

SOP & NABH Compliance

Adherence to applicable hospital policies and procedures

6. General Responsibilities

* Adhere to the hospital's rules, regulations, policies and code of conduct.
* Maintain discipline, punctuality and professional behaviour.
* Ensure the reception area is clean, organized and presentable.
* Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Front Office Supervisor or Hospital Administrator in the interest of patient care and smooth hospital operations.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹17,000.00 per month

description:
**Job Requirements**  

Do you want to help create the future of healthcare? At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere.


We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment with opportunities to go beyond your comfort zone and grow both personally and professionally. Sound interesting?


Then come and join our global Design and User Experience community as a **Sr. User Interaction Design Professional (IXD)** to transform complex user needs into intuitive workflows and meaningful product experiences, driving design excellence and fostering the continuous evolution of digital healthcare solutions.


As part of our team, you will work on next\-generation healthcare solutions for healthcare professionals, patients, and customers. Supported by a collaborative global UX community, you will partner with cross\-functional teams to create impactful digital experiences and improve healthcare outcomes through the power of human\-centred design.

**Please upload your portfolio with your application**.

**Your tasks and responsibilities:**


As a **Senior Interaction Designer**, you will shape digital solutions, workflows, and interaction models for healthcare products across a variety of platforms, helping healthcare professionals work more efficiently and effectively.


In this role, you will design and evolve innovative digital healthcare solutions, contributing to their continuous improvement and development.

* Create and iterate low\- and high\-fidelity prototypes in collaboration with UX researchers, designers, product managers, developers, and business stakeholders, incorporating continuous feedback throughout the design process.
* Optimize user interactions to improve usability, reduce complexity, and deliver seamless user experiences while providing clear design specifications for implementation.
* Continuously develop and refine interaction design patterns, applying your expertise across various technologies, including micro\-interactions, transitions, and animations.
* Partner with UX researchers to translate user insights into meaningful design solutions and implementation\-ready specifications.
* Represent user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, applying human\-centered design methods to inform product decisions.
* Contribute to a strong UX culture by championing design quality, fostering collaboration, and driving the continuous improvement of healthcare experiences across a global, cross\-functional team.

  

**Work Experience**  

**Your qualifications and experience**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in user experience design, human\-computer interaction, or a related field
* A strong portfolio showcasing your interaction design craftsmanship, systems thinking, and problem\-solving skills across complex digital experiences.
* 7\+ years of experience in Interaction Design, Information Architecture, User Experience Design, or a related discipline.
* Proficiency in design tools such as Figma and a willingness to explore new tools and technologies that enhance design outcomes and team effectiveness.
* Proven experience partnering with software development teams, creating implementation\-ready design specifications, and conducting design quality reviews to ensure accurate implementation and adherence to design system standards.
* Experience in medical technology is a plus; curiosity and willingness to dive deep into complex clinical workflows are even more important.

**Your attributes and skills**

* A user\-centered mindset with strong interaction design and problem\-solving skills, capable of transforming complex user needs and workflows into intuitive, efficient experiences.
* Expertise in interaction modeling, information architecture, and prototyping, with a passion for usability, design quality, and attention to detail throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to advocate for user needs and align designers, researchers, developers, product managers, and stakeholders around a shared vision.
* A proactive and collaborative team player who contributes to a strong UX culture, drives design excellence, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve healthcare experiences through human\-centred design.

**Your Mindset**

* Forward\-thinking and quality\-driven mindset: You stay curious, bring fresh ideas, and understand how exceptional interaction design contributes to outstanding product experiences and business success.
* Collaborative ownership mindset: You build strong partnerships across disciplines, take ownership of design outcomes, and are committed to quality from initial concept through final implementation.
* Continuous learning mindset: You actively seek opportunities to learn, stay current with emerging UX \& Interaction design practices, and continuously develop your skills to enhance your impact on the team.


To gain a deeper understanding of the products and services related to this role, please explore these links and visit our company website for more details. https://www.siemens\-healthineers.com/products\-services

We are a team of 66,000 highly dedicated employees across more than 70 countries passionately pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare to help improve people’s lives around the world. As a leader in the industry, we aspire to create better outcomes and experiences for patients no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio, spanning from in\-vitro and in\-vivo diagnostics to image\-guided therapy and innovative cancer care, is crucial for clinical decision\-making and treatment pathways.

We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success. Check our Careers Site

title: Product Implementation Engineer
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**



We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


**CloudSEK****,** one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real\-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.



Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**


* CloudSEK **XVigil** constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's **BeVigil** uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI **SVigil** identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third\-party dependencies.
* CloudSEK’s **AIVigil** is an AI\-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.


**Key Milestones:**


* **2016**: Launched our first product.
* **2018**: Secured Pre\-series A funding.
* **2019**: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020**: Won the NASSCOM\-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021**: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards \& Recognition**: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025**: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.
**Role Overview**



We are looking for a technically sharp and customer\-obsessed Product Implementation Engineer / Onboarding Specialist to own the end\-to\-end onboarding experience for new CloudSEK customers. You will be the critical bridge between our Sales and Engineering teams — ensuring that customers go live quickly, confidently, and with maximum value from day one. You will configure the platform, drive integrations, deliver training, and build scalable onboarding processes that reduce time\-to\-value across our growing customer base.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Customer Onboarding \& Implementation**


* Own the full onboarding lifecycle — from post\-sales kickoff through to successful go\-live — for XVigil, BeVigil, SVigil.
* Conduct discovery sessions to understand each customer's digital asset landscape, threat exposure, and security workflows.
* Configure and customize the CloudSEK platform (alert rules, keyword monitoring, asset inventory) to match customer use cases.
* Manage onboarding timelines, deliverables, and milestone tracking via structured project plans.


**Technical Integration \& API Enablement**


* Guide customers through API integration with their existing security stack — SIEM, SOAR, ticketing systems (Jira, ServiceNow), and threat intelligence platforms.
* Troubleshoot integration issues, work with internal engineering to resolve product\-side blockers, and escalate with full context.
* Support customers leveraging CloudSEK's pre\-built application integrations to automate threat resolution workflows.


**Training \& Enablement**


* Design and deliver tailored product training sessions (live and async) for SOC analysts, CISOs, and IT administrators.
* Create onboarding playbooks, video walkthroughs, knowledge\-base articles, and FAQ resources to enable self\-serve success.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Act as the voice of the customer internally — relay product feedback, onboarding friction points, and feature requests to the Product and Engineering teams.
* Partner with Sales Engineers during pre\-sales to set accurate onboarding expectations and scope implementation requirements.
* Contribute to building a repeatable, scalable onboarding methodology as CloudSEK expands its global customer base.


**Requirements**


**Must\-Have**


* 2–5 years of experience in a technical implementation, solutions engineering, or customer onboarding role — ideally in a SaaS or cybersecurity company.
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity concepts: threat intelligence, digital risk protection, vulnerability management, SIEM/SOAR, or similar.
* Hands\-on experience with REST APIs — able to read API documentation, write sample calls, and debug integration issues independently.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple customer onboardings simultaneously without dropping the ball.
* Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders and vice versa.


**Good to Have**


* Familiarity with the dark/deep web threat intelligence landscape and tools such as XVigil, or similar DRP platforms.
* Experience integrating security tools with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, IBM QRadar) or SOAR platforms (Palo Alto XSOAR, Splunk SOAR).
* Scripting ability in Python or JavaScript to build lightweight automation or integration utilities for customers.
* Prior experience creating technical documentation, runbooks, or onboarding curricula.
**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**



We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:


* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.


And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!


CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

* ### **Network Solution Design \& Implementation:** **Architect and deploy tailored LAN/WAN solutions, including IP and VoIP configurations, that align with customer requirements and prepare systems for go\-live and maintenance.**
* ### **Troubleshooting \& Maintenance:** **Identify and resolve network issues, maintain system stability, and coordinate with third\-party vendors to install and update hardware and software.**
* ### **Project Management \& Planning:** **Review project requirements, translate them accurately to team members, conduct cost analyses, and oversee project timelines to ensure full delivery.**
* ### **Proof of Concept (PoC) Development:** **Build and test PoC models utilizing modern networking system technologies to showcase viability for prospective architecture changes.**
* ### **Technical Consultation:** **Act as a subject matter expert across all phases of the network solution lifecycle, providing high\-quality guidance to both internal teams and client stakeholders.**

  

### **What You Bring**

  

* ### **Core Networking Expertise:** **Hands\-on experience with routers, switches, network controllers, bridges, and enterprise networking software.**
* ### **Protocol \& Architecture Knowledge:** **Strong technical proficiency in IP, VoIP, multi\-platform LAN/WAN design, and underlying networking protocols.**
* ### **Problem\-Solving \& Diagnostics:** **Proven track record in troubleshooting complex network infrastructure and hardware/software integration issues.**
* ### **Project \& Financial Acumen:** **Ability to analyze project scope, estimate costs, manage implementation steps, and clearly communicate technical requirements to multi\-disciplinary teams.**
* ### **Vendor \& Client Management:** **Skilled in liaising with external hardware/software vendors and providing technical service to clients.**

  

**Who You Are**

### **You’re good**

### **What you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.**

### **Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* ### **6\+ years of experience focused on network support, configuration, and implementation**
* ### **6\+ years of experience in core switching, routing, MPLS, and firewalls**
* ### **Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains.**
* ### **Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision**

  

### **Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* ### **Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) deployment and data center experience.**
* ### **Experience with design and implementing Software Defined Network (SDN) and large complex networks.**
* ### **Experience with protocols and technologies such as, BDP, OSPF, MP\-FBP EVPN, VXLAN, or VPC.**

### **Your future at Kyndryl**

  

### **Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries,**

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.J

  

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

 **Job Introduction**

  

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer\-facing, primarily servicing walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client\-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

 **Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Provide high\-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross\-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.

 **Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

  

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

 **Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

  

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well\-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self\-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

 **Regulatory Certifications:**

  

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – RECEPTIONIST

**Organization:** Orange Child Development Centre  
**Department:** Administration / Front Office  
**Position:** Receptionist  
**Reporting To:** Clinic Coordinator / Branch Manager / Centre Head  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, Monday to Saturday  
**Location:** Orange Child Development Centre – As assigned by Management

Role Overview

The Receptionist is the first point of contact for parents, children, visitors, therapists, and other stakeholders at Orange Child Development Centre.

The role requires a professional, friendly, organized, and responsible individual who can efficiently manage front\-office operations, appointments, parent communication, payments, records, and routine administrative responsibilities while ensuring a welcoming experience for every family visiting the centre.

Key ResponsibilitiesFront Office \& Parent Relations

* Welcome parents, children, visitors, and guests in a professional and friendly manner.
* Attend incoming calls, WhatsApp enquiries, and walk\-in enquiries.
* Understand the basic services offered by Orange CDC and provide appropriate information to parents.
* Direct parents and visitors to the appropriate therapist, coordinator, or department.
* Maintain a positive, supportive, and child\-friendly environment at the reception.
* Handle parent concerns professionally and escalate clinical or sensitive matters to the Clinic Coordinator or Centre Head.

Appointment \& Session Management

* Schedule therapy sessions, assessments, consultations, and follow\-up appointments.
* Coordinate therapist schedules and available time slots.
* Confirm appointments with parents and communicate changes or cancellations promptly.
* Track attendance, cancellations, rescheduling, and missed sessions.
* Ensure appointment and session records are updated accurately on a daily basis.
* Coordinate with therapists regarding client arrival, schedule changes, and session requirements.

Billing, Payments \& Cash Handling

* Collect therapy fees, assessment charges, package payments, and other approved payments.
* Generate receipts/invoices as per company procedure.
* Maintain accurate records of cash, UPI, bank transfers, card payments, and other payment modes.
* Reconcile daily collections and submit accurate closing reports.
* Ensure that cash balances and payment records match at the end of each working day.
* Immediately report any payment discrepancy or variation to the management.
* Follow up with parents regarding pending payments when instructed.

Administrative Responsibilities

* Maintain client registration details, consent forms, attendance records, payment records, and other administrative documentation.
* Support the Clinic Coordinator and management with routine documentation and administrative tasks.
* Maintain reception registers and required office records.
* Assist in printing, scanning, filing, photocopying, and organizing documents.
* Ensure confidentiality of client, child, parent, employee, and organizational information.
* Maintain proper communication between therapists, management, parents, and other departments.

Enquiry \& Follow\-Up Management

* Record all new enquiries accurately.
* Follow up with prospective parents regarding assessments, consultations, and therapy services.
* Coordinate with the assessment and clinical team for new client appointments.
* Follow up with parents who have missed appointments or have not continued services, when instructed.
* Update enquiry status and conversion information regularly.
* Support management in basic outreach and follow\-up activities where required.

Reception \& Centre Maintenance

* Ensure the reception and waiting area remain clean, organized, and presentable.
* Coordinate with housekeeping and support staff regarding cleanliness and basic centre requirements.
* Monitor stationery and reception supplies and inform management when replenishment is required.
* Ensure brochures, forms, registers, and other reception materials are properly maintained.
* Ensure proper opening and closing procedures of the reception area are followed.

Daily Reporting \& Closing

* Complete daily collection and payment reconciliation.
* Update appointment, attendance, enquiry, and payment records.
* Prepare and submit daily closing reports as required.
* Ensure all cash and financial records are properly handed over or secured before leaving.
* Inform the reporting manager about any unresolved parent concerns, payment issues, scheduling conflicts, or operational issues.

Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional telephone and WhatsApp communication.
* Basic computer knowledge, including MS Word, Excel, email, and online systems.
* Good organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Accuracy in cash handling and record keeping.
* Ability to communicate politely and confidently with parents.
* Ability to work calmly in a busy clinical environment.
* Good coordination and problem\-solving abilities.
* Responsible, punctual, disciplined, and trustworthy.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.

Preferred Qualification

* Graduate or Diploma holder in any discipline.
* Previous experience in reception, front office, healthcare, hospital, clinic, therapy centre, school, or customer service is preferred.
* Candidates with experience handling billing, appointments, or parent/customer communication will be given preference.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy of billing and cash handling.
* Appointment and scheduling accuracy.
* Parent/customer service quality.
* Timeliness of follow\-ups.
* Accuracy of attendance and administrative records.
* Enquiry handling and conversion support.
* Daily reporting and closing accuracy.
* Punctuality, discipline, and attendance.
* Coordination with therapists and management.
* Professional behaviour and communication.

Professional Conduct

The Receptionist is expected to maintain high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, integrity, and respectful communication at all times.

Any information regarding children, parents, therapy plans, employee matters, payments, or internal company operations must be treated as confidential and should not be disclosed to unauthorized persons.

The employee must follow all policies, SOPs, administrative procedures, child protection guidelines, and instructions issued by Orange Child Development Centre management.

**Orange Child Development Centre**  
*Supporting Children. Empowering Families.*

title: Mainframe WAS MQ Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. **The Role**

As a Mainframe WAS MQ Systems Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  

  

There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day\-to\-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.  



  

Key Responsibilities :  



  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS) for z/OS and IBM MQ environments across development, test, and production systems.
* Administer MQ Queue Managers, Queue Sharing Groups (QSG), Sysplex environments, and Coupling Facility structures to ensure high availability and performance.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting of WAS and MQ issues, including JVM crashes, thread dumps, application failures, queue management, and performance bottlenecks.
* Monitor, tune, and optimize middleware infrastructure using tools such as OMEGAMON, RMF, MQ Explorer, Dynatrace, SYSVIEW, and BMC MainView.
* Design and implement MQ clustering, workload balancing, disaster recovery, backup, recovery, and business continuity solutions.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using wsadmin (Jython), REXX, and shell scripting to improve operational efficiency and deployment processes.
* Implement and maintain security controls including SSL/TLS, JAAS, SAF integration, RACF policies, and MQ security best practices.
Participate in 24x7 on\-call support, major incident management, root cause analysis, documentation, and mentoring of junior administrators while driving continuous service improvements.  
* 

  

At Kyndryl, we're committed to providing the best possible service to our customers, and as a Systems Management Specialist, you'll be an integral part of that mission. So if you're passionate about technology and want to be part of a dynamic team that's shaping the future of IT infrastructure management – then this role is for you.  



  

Your Future at Kyndryl


Kyndryl's focus on providing innovative IT solutions to its customers means that in Systems Management, you will be working with the latest technology and will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills. You may also have the opportunity to work on large\-scale projects and collaborate with other IT professionals from around the world.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  



  

  

Required Technical and Professional Expertise  



  

* 6 to 10 years of experience in IBM WebSphere Application Server for z/OS (WASz) administration and IBM MQ support.
* Strong experience in installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IBM MQ environments.
* Hands\-on expertise with Queue Sharing Groups (QSG) and Coupling Facility technologies.
* Experience with MQ Explorer, Tivoli Monitoring, OMEGAMON, SYSVIEW, BMC MainView, MQATTACH, and ICC.
* Strong understanding of MQ clustering, distributed integration, and workload balancing concepts.
* Knowledge of workload management (WLM), high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity practices.
* Experience in system backup, recovery, performance analysis, and root\-cause troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of z/OS operating environments and middleware architecture.
Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.  
* 

  

  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience  



  

* IBM Certified System Administrator – WebSphere Application Server for z/OS certification.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise IBM Z environments with mission\-critical workloads.
* Experience with middleware upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Exposure to CICS, Db2, IMS, and other IBM Z middleware technologies.
Experience working in global delivery and 24x7 support environments.  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

description:

Experience

* Smooth hospital operations during the night shift.

* Staff discipline and attendance.

description:
**Job Title: ServiceNow Senior Administrator**

**About the Role**


We are looking for a ServiceNow Senior Administrator to manage the day‑to‑day health, stability, and configuration of our ServiceNow platform. This role requires strong hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM, solid understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to support enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and guide junior team members. You will work closely with developers, process owners, and platform stakeholders to ensure the system runs smoothly and follows best practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily administration of the ServiceNow platform, including user management, roles, groups, and access controls.
* Maintain and improve core modules such as ITSM and CMDB; experience with ITAM, ITOM, HRSD, or SecOps is a plus.
* Configure and manage forms, fields, lists, UI policies, UI actions, and basic workflow or Flow Designer logic.
* Support platform upgrades, patches, regression testing, and general maintenance activities.
* Monitor data quality across key tables, including CMDB, ITSM, SAM/HAM, and ITOM‑related records.
* Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement long‑term fixes.
* Assist with catalog items, record producers, notifications, and workflow automation.
* Work with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into configuration tasks.
* Maintain clear documentation for configuration changes, processes, and platform updates.
* Provide guidance to junior admins and support teams on platform standards and best practices.

**Core Skills \& Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, tables, forms, ACLs, and role‑based access.
* Hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM (required).
* Working knowledge of Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Flow Designer.
* Familiarity with Script Includes, Glide APIs, and basic scripting (JavaScript).
* Understanding of integrations, Scripted REST APIs, and data exchange concepts.
* Good awareness of CMDB relationships, data models, and data quality practices.
* Experience with Service Portal or UI customization is helpful.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6\+ years of hands‑on experience administering or developing in ServiceNow.
* Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Experience supporting upgrades, maintenance, and platform improvements.
* Background working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* ServiceNow CSA certification required or in progress; additional certifications (ITSM, CMDB, HRSD, ITAM) are a plus.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business teams.
* Ability to mentor junior team members and support platform governance.

title: Infrastructure SME network automation
description:

You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem\-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  

  

In this role, you’ll balance hands\-on delivery with long\-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  

  

What you will do

Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging technologies while pursuing certifications and advancing toward senior technical leadership roles.  
* 

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.


Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with other  



  

Required skills and experience
  

  

* Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands\-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain

Preferred skills and experience  

  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail
  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: System Administrator I
description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.
### **Role Overview:**


The System Administrator I is responsible for the administration, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise IT infrastructure within a 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) environment. This role ensures high availability, performance, and security of systems across on\-premises and cloud environments.  

The incumbent will manage incident resolution, system maintenance, network configurations, and cloud operations, while delivering high\-quality support to internal stakeholders and customers. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and adherence to operational and security standards.### **Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Incident \& Service Management  

* Monitor, triage, and resolve incidents within defined SLAs, ensuring timely escalation where required.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Document resolutions, root causes, and updates in accordance with operational processes.
* Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Microsoft ecosystem and Windows server environments.


2\. System Monitoring \& Infrastructure Management  

* Proactively monitor infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog,PagerDuty).
* Respond to alerts across critical, warning, and error thresholds.
* Perform system upgrades, patch management, and scheduled maintenance activities.
* Manage and optimize server resources including CPU, memory, and storage capacity.


3\. Network Administration  

* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network connectivity including static, dynamic, and failover tunnels.
* Perform routing updates, ASA licensing activities, and IP whitelisting tasks.
* Execute network security tasks such as IP blocking (shunning) and tunnel resets.


4\. Identity \& Access Management (IAM)  

* Administer Active Directory (AD) user accounts, group memberships, and access policies.

* Support identity synchronization between AD and Okta environments.
* Provision and maintain internal and customer user accounts in alignment with security policies.


5\. Database Administration Support  

* Manage database\-level access control, including granting and revoking SQL permissions.
* Support integration of identity groups with database systems.


6\. Cloud Infrastructure (AWS) Management  

* Configure and manage AWS services including EC2, S3, and IAM components.
* Monitor cloud utilization and implement cost optimization measures.
* Perform scheduled backups, scaling, and disaster recovery support activities.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure and application\-level issues within cloud environments.
* Integrate cloud services with on\-premises and third\-party systems.


7\. Technical Support \& Troubleshooting  

* Diagnose and resolve system performance issues, IIS services, hardware concerns, and access\-related issues.
* Manage service configurations, permissions, and software installations.
* Support authentication\-related issues including MFA resets and monitoring tool components.


8\. AI Enablement in NOC Operations  

* Utilize AI tools to support operational efficiency in incident analysis and reporting.
* Perform summarization of alerts, logs, and incident data for operational insights.
* Develop structured prompts for root cause analysis, escalation notes, and customer communications.
* Validate AI\-generated outputs before operational use.
* Ensure adherence to data security and confidentiality standards when using AI tools.

### **Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in System Administration or NOC operations.
* Experience with monitoring tools..
* Strong knowledge of networking concepts including VPNs, tunnels, and ASA configurations.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Okta, SQL, and server administration practices.
* Ability to manage priorities effectively in a fast\-paced, 24/7 operational environment.

### **Preferred Skills:**


Technical Expertise:
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, systems, and cloud technologies.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills for stakeholder interaction.
* Adherence to processes, documentation standards, and compliance requirements.

Analytical:
* Proven troubleshooting and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with internal and external teams.

### **Work Environment:**

* Hybrid work model (Work From Office / Work From Home).
* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including night shifts and weekends.
* Availability outside standard business hours based on operational requirements.

### **Behavioral Competencies:**



* Ensures Accountability
* Manages Complexity
* Communicates Effectively
* Balances Stakeholders
* Collaborates Effectively
  


PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Supervise inventory management of IT equipment including company phones, monitors, PCs, and software, ensuring accuracy and accountability
* Ensure adherence to all IT standards, policies, and procedures, and enforce compliance within the team

* **Microsoft Certified: Security Administrator Associate**
* **Microsoft Certified: Teams Administrator Associate**

This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.
